bushwick.name: Bushwick, Brooklyn
bushwick.function: Primary domestic neighborhood and social integration terrain
bushwick.behavior: Lived-in contemporary neighborhood. Residents are busy, observant, transactional, sometimes helpful, and not generally astonished by Vikings.

municipalNYC.name: NYC municipal system
municipalNYC.function: DTI, DMV, inspections, filing, hearings, and other procedural spaces
municipalNYC.behavior: Underfunded, procedural, inconsistent, staffed by ordinary people working inside rules and resource limits.

transitNYC.name: NYC transit system
transitNYC.behavior: Routes, gates, cards, booths, crowd flow, and transfers become learnable infrastructure rather than magical machinery.

eastRiver.name: East River waterfront
eastRiver.behavior: Ordinary working urban waterfront carrying emotional memory of arrival rather than mystical time-travel energy.
